text:
Elaine S (Sales): Acme wants SOC2 excerpt + ISO artifacts for the POC, a signed pen-test attestation, and staging IP ranges. Deadline next Fri EOD. Can we confirm what we can hand off and whether VPC+KMS affects the Dedicated quote?

Raj (SE): We can provide redacted SOC2 sections, ISO27001 scope statement, one-page pen-test attestation, redacted network diagram, and SSO/SCIM notes. VPC+external-KMS usually adds ~20% to Dedicated; will confirm exact line item.

Marta (Security): We can sign our standard pen-test attestation. Need customer legal contact for signature. We do not provide raw vuln reports without separate legal agreement. If they insist on raw findings, expect legal review.

Frank (Ops): Ops can allocate a small CIDR and jumpbox for the staging window and issue presigned S3 upload links for their evidence. Note: reserved burst capacity changes billing for the POC period.

Elaine S (Sales): Paste the pen-test attestation text and presign example please. Also: do we use a dataroom or presigned S3 for delivery?

Raj (SE): Pen-test attestation sample: "Redwood Inference attests that on [DATE] an external penetration test by [VENDOR] covered production and designated staging endpoints. Critical/high issues were remediated or mitigated prior to onboarding. Detailed raw reports are not released without separate agreement."

Raj (SE): Presign example: aws s3 presign s3://redwood-proofpack/acme-poc/evidence.zip --expires-in 604800

Marta (Security): If customer requires HSM-backed keys or external KMS, that triggers an enterprise review and ~2 week lead time. Full SOC2 Type II access requires NDA/dataroom controls.

Frank (Ops): Example staging IPs (redacted): 13.32.120.0/28 (jumpbox), 13.32.121.0/28 (test agents). Final IPs assigned when staging window is scheduled.

evidence-bot: New ticket EVIDENCE-12345 created and assigned to Raj (SE), Marta (Security), Frank (Ops).

Elaine S (Sales): Thanks -- I'll ask Acme for legal signer, dataroom vs presign preference, and whether they need raw findings. Target internal delivery Thu EOD so their security team can review on Friday. :thumbsup:
